semiconductor_relevance: High — Hexin Semiconductor Technology specializes in integrated circuit chip testing solutions, making it a key player in the semiconductor testing segment.
summary: Hexin Semiconductor Technology provides comprehensive testing solutions for integrated circuit chips, catering to chip design companies, wafer fabs, and packaging plants. Their offerings include semiconductor test board manufacturing, probe card R&D, and customized software development, ensuring a full-chain service from product supply to after-sales maintenance.

regional_presence.China: Hexin Semiconductor Technology is based in Suzhou, China, focusing on the domestic semiconductor market.
